title: trema velutinum
intro: Trema velutinum, commonly known as Monkey tree or Monkey vine, is a tropical plant species in the family Cannabaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly for its ability to reduce inflammation, lower blood pressure, and alleviate fever. The health benefits of Trema velutinum include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and cardiovascular protective actions, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as vasodilation and antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of Trema velutinum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
